changeHypothesis.persistenceReason: Demand weakness can persist until subsidies/base effects/product cycles normalize.
disconfirmingEvidence: CATL had already rerated sharply, creating a divergence between one stock and weak physical market demand.
Tesla localization is separately modeled and must not be generalized to the whole NEV market.
